How to read this report

Impact: High / Medium / Low, set by keyword rules (penalty, mandatory, must ...).

Action required: The change states an obligation or a step the firm must take.

Open action: Action required and the status is not Actioned.

Deadline / Days left: Date taken from the text of the change; days left are counted from the date of the data (not the day the file is opened). Red = overdue, amber = due within 30 days.

Departments: A change reaches a department through its topics (AML/CTF and Sanctions go to Compliance, Payroll and Super to HR and to Accounts ...), so department totals add up to more than the firm total.

Heatmap: Department x agency; a darker green cell means more changes.

Cost and hours: Staff time x loaded hourly rate + external spend (advisers, systems), from stated assumptions in impact_model.py. Not quotes and not legal advice.

Capacity: Hours each role needs for regulatory work in a month against the hours it has for it.

Weekly trend: One row per weekly run, kept in the Databricks lakehouse (bronze, quality gate, silver, gold). In sample mode the synthetic year is replayed week by week through the same pipeline.

Data: Source = GitHub CSV (Dataset = bi_export synthetic year or data/live weekly monitor) or Databricks (gold tables). Source health always shows the latest real weekly run.
